source_text: 本次合成任务采用已验证案例 valid-docs-backfill；各字段以该案例的公开输入为准，不追加资料外事实。

review_checks: 核对所有事实能在输入资料或已接受引用中找到。
核对输出满足 Design permission-aware, evidence-backed, reversible agent execution and handoff
缺失或未确认信息必须明确标注；不得新增授权、执行或生产完成声明。

inputs.permissions: repo-local writes allowed; anything sending external messages requires explicit user approval
inputs.task: Backfill fictional release notes for three tagged versions from local git history
inputs.tools: git log (read-only), file editor (reversible write in repo), no network tools

review_checks: 缺少必填字段 deliverable，必须补齐后再确认。
